messages:
raja: Kickoff  coordinating a multi-service rollout tonight 01:45 UTC. Need final sign-off on pins + an explicit rollback map for api/runtime/console/router. Keeping it low-noise during the window.

raja: Proposed pins -> api@3.4.8, runtime@2.9.2-q, console@0.5.9, router@1.7.3. Rollout waves: 3% canary, then 25%, then 100%.

kai: ok on pins. runtime change includes the batching kernel and new kv-ttl tweak. For canary let's set batch_limit=48 and kv_ttl=15m.

mel: console change touches header framing. We must ensure router preserves x-rd-context header untouched. If header drops, console should return 422 for that request path, not cascade 500s.

oncall: Rollback triggers I agree with: sustained 5xx > 1.8% for 5m OR p95 latency increase > 250ms for 5m OR kv eviction spike > 8k/min. Add immediate abort on node OOM or disk>92%.

ops: infra plan: pre-warm +2 runtime nodes, set autoscale buffer 30%. Router drain timeout 90s. Also will enable connection-level short-circuit at router if error-rate > 1.2% for 2m.

raja: Good. Deploybot, schedule with abort hooks and the fallback pins to execute on abort: api->3.4.5, runtime->2.9.0, router->1.6.11, console->0.5.6.

deploybot: Acknowledged. I'll create an orchestrated job and stream updates here.

raja: Deploy command we'll use (template):
```
/deploy start --waves "[3,25,100]" --pins "api@3.4.8 runtime@2.9.2-q console@0.5.9 router@1.7.3" --canary-flags "runtime.batch_limit=48 runtime.kv_ttl=15m" --abort-hooks "5xx>1.8%:5m,p95>250:5m,kv_evictions>8000:5m,oom:0m,disk>92:1m" --fallback "api@3.4.5 runtime@2.9.0 router@1.6.11 console@0.5.6"
```

mel: I'll run a last-minute header-pass test in staging and post results. If any mismatch we hold.

ux: I'll freeze new console UX flags for the window. Will flip after full roll.

oncall: monitoring set. I'll add a short synthetic that hits the header path every 30s to detect regressions quickly.

ops: setting up dashboards and an alert with paging threshold at 1.2% 5xx for 3m to get eyes early.

raja: final thumbs? We want minimal replies unless abort.

kai: +1

mel: +1 (staging header-pass green)

oncall: +1, oncall ready

ops: +1 infra green

deploybot: Job scheduled: id=job-17150099, start=1715005500 (01:45 UTC), owner=@raja. Will post canary start and step updates to this thread and #eng-releases/deploy-logs. Preflight checks passed.
